== Summary ==
Identified: [[Tom Haid]] (far left, black Japanese-text T-shirt), [[Casey Anis]] (foreground, black polo), [[Barry Alperstein]] (center, plaid shirt), and [[Greg Shaw]] (right, Outrider Cup 2019 hoodie).
Top 8 players after the cut. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).
